gloss: toddler food; food for young children

definitions.gloss: toddler food; food for young children
definitions.explanation: meals and food products designed for children roughly ages 1 to 5, transitioning from baby food to regular adult meals

examples.japanese: {幼児食|ようじしょく}のレシピを{調|しら}べた。
examples.english: I looked up toddler food recipes.

examples.japanese: {離乳食|りにゅうしょく}から{幼児食|ようじしょく}への{切|き}り{替|か}えが{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: The transition from baby food to toddler food is difficult.

examples.japanese: {幼児食|ようじしょく}は{薄味|うすあじ}で{柔|やわ}らかく{調理|ちょうり}するのが{基本|きほん}だ。
examples.english: The basics of toddler food are cooking with mild flavors and soft textures.

notes:
Combines {幼児|ようじ} (infant, toddler) and {食|しょく} (food, meal). Refers to the stage of eating between {離乳食|りにゅうしょく} (weaning food/baby food) and regular meals. In Japan, there are many commercial products, cookbooks, and parenting resources dedicated to this stage of childhood nutrition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幼児食|ようじしょく}レシピ: toddler food recipe
- {幼児食|ようじしょく}に{移行|いこう}する: to transition to toddler food
- {幼児食|ようじしょく}メニュー: toddler food menu
- {市販|しはん}の{幼児食|ようじしょく}: commercially available toddler food

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {離乳食|りにゅうしょく}: baby food, weaning food — food for the earlier stage (around 5-18 months)
- {給食|きゅうしょく}: school lunch — meals provided at schools and nurseries
- {介護食|かいごしょく}: care food — soft food designed for elderly people with difficulty chewing
